title: q--exchangeable Measures and Transformations in Interacting Particle Systems
comment: Comments are welcome! Accessibility statement: a WCAG 2.1AA compliant version of this PDF will eventually be available at http://tailorswiftbot.godaddysites.com/september-2024-paper
abstract: This paper provides unified calculations regarding certain measures and transformations in interacting particle systems. More specifically, we provide certain general conditions under which an interacting particle system will have a reversible measure, gauge transformation, or ground state transformation. Additionally, we provide a method to prove that these conditions hold. This method uses certain quantum groups, and in that context the general conditions specialize to a \(q\)--exchangeable property.
